title: M-LOCK — the central PC: exclusive lease, FIFO queue, fencing (the part that must never lie)
desc:
DELIVERABLE: the PC lock as a module of tools/world.py + tests — docs/WORLD.md section 4 exactly. acquire (free -> granted, generation += 1, fresh opaque token; held -> FIFO queue; recovering -> refused until sweep); renew (token match; max_hold_min 180 default); release (holder only; queue head gets a NEW generation); expiry -> state recovering — NEVER auto-handover; sweep -> release + grant next; cancel; status.
Executor side: a fake-action harness that REFUSES any action carrying a stale token or generation (fencing proven, not promised).
EVIDENCE: the parallel test — 5 CONCURRENT acquires (separate processes), exactly one winner + 4 queued; release -> queue head gets generation n+2; a stale-token action refused with the reason printed. Paste lock.json before/after. tests/test_world_lock.py.
OWNS: tools/world.py (lock module), tests/test_world_lock.py.
NOTE: the git push race IS the mutex — losers re-read and queue, never overwrite. Keep lock.json small enough for the map to draw holder/purpose/since/queue directly.
BRANCH: agent/<you>/<task-id>

history.note: DELIVERED by vesta, paired with M-STATE (mars @02bcc0d). The lock, per docs/WORLD.md §4: acquire (free→grant, generation+1, fresh token; held→FIFO queue; recovering→refused, sweep first; holder re-acquire and duplicate queue entries refused), renew (holder+token, max_hold 180 enforced), release (queue head granted with a NEW generation + token), sweep (expired→recovering, never a silent handover; grants next), cancel, status, check-token (the executor's fence). THE RACE, proven: five simultaneous acquires from five separate clones of one origin — exactly one GRANTED, four QUEUED (positions 1-4), generation exactly 1, origin lock: 1 holder + 4 queue; winner's release → generation 2, fresh token, and the old token is REFUSED at check-token (TOKEN-REFUSED reason=stale). Under the hood: the push race IS the mutex — a lost push drops the attempt, jitters, re-reads the remote and re-decides (base-bytes comparison, up to 30 rounds); no lock is ever silently handed over. EVIDENCE: tests/test_world_lock.py — semantics (grant/renew/release/expiry/sweep/cancel/fence) + the race + queue advance, all green; the full suite is 19/19 from a cold clone. OWNS: tools/world.py (lock module), tests/test_world_lock.py. Review card t-2197 cover this + M-STATE together — try to break it.
